findings.title: Note: known test failures in runner gate (root-only unwritable-parent test; load-sensitive control-character flake)
findings.evidence: 03-verification+gate.txt lines 146-148: 2 failed, 2062 passed, 1 skipped; failures are test_control_characters_reach_the_shell and test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused
findings.consequence: None for a markdown-only diff; both are pre-identified environment issues

findings.title: Section 5.4 state-survival table cites section 4.1 for experiments that are not described there
findings.evidence: docs/00-working/terminal-persistence-audit.md section 5.4 table header says 'all from section 4.1's experiments'; no step in 4.1 or 5.1 collapses or drops then switches layout, so the 'kept' entries in the Layout switch column have no recorded steps
findings.consequence: A reader cannot trace three table cells to a recorded experiment, and they may be inferred rather than measured
findings.minimal_fix: Add the one-line step list for collapse/drop then layout switch, or relabel those cells as inferred from the stable host-element mechanism

findings.title: Cause of the false cap refusals is stated as fact and described inconsistently
findings.evidence: Section 6.1 says the slot is free about 2 ms after close; section 6.5 says it is held 'until its deferred close lands'; O10 says 'until the first session's shell is reaped'; F9 says close() does not wait for the child
findings.consequence: The mechanism is inferred from the dev versus production contrast (2 of 4 versus 0 of 4) but reads as established; owner may over-trust it when designing the O10 probe
findings.minimal_fix: Phrase it as 'consistent with' the StrictMode double mount and use one wording in 6.5 and O10

findings.title: Headline connect and echo figures cannot be regenerated exactly from appendix A
findings.evidence: Section 6.1 reports 30 connections per path and 6.2 reports 300 writes at 30 ms; appendix A script runs 20 connects and 200 echoes at 40 ms and measures last-byte-of-startup as well as first byte
findings.consequence: Limited reproducibility; disclosed in the text but the owner's O6/O7 numbers will not be like-for-like on sample count
findings.minimal_fix: State the parameter differences in one sentence or reproduce the 30/300 variant

findings.title: Bash Communication column labelled Measured (Linux) but includes code-search claims
findings.evidence: Section 4.1 column header; page reload cell relies on 'searched ts/src' for no beforeunload prompt, section 5.6 for no keepalive, and connectionRefusalMessage text, which section 1 defines as Code reading
findings.consequence: Minor label looseness; each claim names its basis inline so nothing is misleading
findings.minimal_fix: Tag those entries as Code reading in the cell text
